title: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation

blocks.tex:
The construction uses curvature and edge lengths. This chapter records the
geometric bridges to actual polygons and to Tabachnikov's statement in terms of
circumcircle radii. It also gives the polygonal turning theorem needed by the
enclosing-circle argument in the continuity obstruction.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-controller-smooth
blocks.title: Smoothness of the development inside the strict walls
blocks.body:
Fix a curvature vector $\kappa$ and a length vector $\ell$. If every incident
arcsine argument has absolute value less than one, then the turning angles,
cumulative headings, total turn, and complex closure gap are $C^1$ in $\ell$
near this vector, even when some entries of $\ell$ vanish.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (i : ZMod n)
    (hw1 : |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1)
    (hw2 : |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => turningAngle 0 κ L i) ℓ := by
  rw [abs_lt] at hw1 hw2
  have hlin1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => κ i * (L (i - 1) / 2)) ℓ := by
    fun_prop
  have hlin2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => κ i * (L i / 2)) ℓ := by
    fun_prop
  have ha1 := (Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw1.1)
    (ne_of_lt hw1.2)).comp ℓ hlin1
  have ha2 := (Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw2.1)
    (ne_of_lt hw2.2)).comp ℓ hlin2
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, turningAngle, tK_zero] using ha1.add ha2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_closureGap_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_closureGap_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => closureGap κ L) ℓ := by
  unfold closureGap vertexR2
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro j hj
  have hheading : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => heading κ L j) ℓ := by
    apply contDiffAt_heading_lengths j
    intro m hm
    exact hw (m : ZMod n)
  have hlength : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => (L (j : ZMod n) : ℂ)) ℓ :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp ℓ (by fun_prop)
  have hheadingC : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => (heading κ L j : ℂ)) ℓ :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp ℓ hheading
  exact hlength.mul ((hheadingC.mul contDiffAt_const).cexp)

/-! ## The opening theorem -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_turningSum_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_turningSum_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => turningSum κ L) ℓ := by
  unfold turningSum
  exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ =>
    contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths i (hw i).1 (hw i).2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_heading_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_heading_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (j : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
      |κ (m : ZMod n) * (ℓ ((m : ZMod n) - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧
        |κ (m : ZMod n) * (ℓ (m : ZMod n) / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => heading κ L j) ℓ := by
  unfold heading
  exact ContDiffAt.sum fun m hm =>
    contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths (m : ZMod n) (hw m hm).1 (hw m hm).2

blocks.tex:
Each turning angle is the sum
$\arcsin(\kappa_i\ell_{i-1}/2)+\arcsin(\kappa_i\ell_i/2)$.
The arguments are linear in the lengths and remain in $(-1,1)$ locally,
where arcsine is smooth. Finite sums give the headings and total turn.
The closure gap is a finite sum $\sum_j\ell_j e^{i\psi_j}$, hence is $C^1$
by composition and multiplication. The phase identities used in cyclic
reindexing are simply $e^{i(a+b)}=e^{ia}e^{ib}$ and $e^{i(a+2\pi)}=e^{ia}$.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-secant-square
blocks.title: Hopf's secant-square identity
blocks.body:
For two disjoint closed segments $AB$ and $CD$, write
$\operatorname{turn}(u,w)=\arg(w/u)$. Then
\[
 \operatorname{turn}(C-A,D-A)+\operatorname{turn}(D-A,D-B)
 =\operatorname{turn}(C-A,C-B)+\operatorname{turn}(C-B,D-B).
\]
This is an equality of real principal angles, not only modulo $2\pi$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.principalTurn
lean.code:
noncomputable def principalTurn (u w : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Complex.arg (w / u)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.principalTurn_secant_square_of_disjoint_segments
lean.code:
theorem principalTurn_secant_square_of_disjoint_segments
    {A B C D : ℂ}
    (hdisj : Disjoint (segment ℝ A B) (segment ℝ C D)) :
    principalTurn (C - A) (D - A) +
        principalTurn (D - A) (D - B) =
      principalTurn (C - A) (C - B) +
        principalTurn (C - B) (D - B) := by
  let Q : Set ℂ := segment ℝ C D - segment ℝ A B
  have hQconvex : Convex ℝ Q :=
    (convex_segment C D).sub (convex_segment A B)
  have hQcompact : IsCompact Q := by
    dsimp [Q]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact (isCompact_segment_complex C D).add
      (isCompact_segment_complex A B).neg
  have hzeroQ : (0 : ℂ) ∉ Q := by
    intro hzero
    rcases Set.mem_sub.mp hzero with ⟨c, hc, a, ha, hca⟩
    have hEq : c = a := sub_eq_zero.mp hca
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj ha (hEq ▸ hc)
  obtain ⟨f, u, hfu, hsep⟩ :=
    RCLike.geometric_hahn_banach_point_closed (𝕜 := ℂ)
      hQconvex hQcompact.isClosed hzeroQ
  have hu : 0 < u := by
    simpa using hfu
  let c : ℂ := f 1
  have hf_apply (q : ℂ) : f q = q * c := by
    change f q = q * f 1
    calc
      f q = f (q • (1 : ℂ)) := by simp
      _ = q • f 1 := f.map_smul q 1
      _ = q * f 1 := by simp [smul_eq_mul]
  have hright {q : ℂ} (hq : q ∈ Q) : 0 < (c * q).re := by
    have h := hu.trans (hsep q hq)
    rw [hf_apply, mul_comm] at h
    exact h
  have hCA : C - A ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (left_mem_segment ℝ C D) (left_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  have hDA : D - A ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (right_mem_segment ℝ C D) (left_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  have hCB : C - B ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (left_mem_segment ℝ C D) (right_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  have hDB : D - B ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (right_mem_segment ℝ C D) (right_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  rw [principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hCA) (hright hDA),
    principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hDA) (hright hDB),
    principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hCA) (hright hCB),
    principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hCB) (hright hDB)]
  ring

/-! ## Finite Hopf-grid cancellation -/

blocks.tex:
The difference of the two segments is compact, convex, and excludes zero.
Strict separation gives a rotation placing all four secant vectors in one
open half-plane. In that half-plane the turn is the ordinary difference of
two arguments in an interval of length $\pi$. Both sides therefore telescope
to the same difference. Multiplying all secants by the separating rotation
does not change their quotients.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-umlaufsatz
blocks.title: The positive polygonal turning theorem
blocks.body:
For a simple cyclic polygon whose successive triples all have positive signed
area, each principal edge turn lies in $(0,\pi)$ and their sum is exactly
$2\pi$. Thus the canonical lifted edge heading advances once per period.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HasPositiveTurningNumberOne
lean.code:
def HasPositiveTurningNumberOne (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  cyclicEdgeHeading v n = cyclicEdgeHeading v 0 + 2 * Real.pi

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeHeading
lean.code:
noncomputable def cyclicEdgeHeading (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => Complex.arg (cyclicEdge v 0)
  | k + 1 => cyclicEdgeHeading v k + cyclicEdgeTurn v k

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation
lean.code:
theorem hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))) :
    HasPositiveTurningNumberOne v :=
  positivePolygonalUmlaufsatz n v hsimple horient

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.positivePolygonalUmlaufsatz
lean.code:
theorem positivePolygonalUmlaufsatz : PositivePolygonalUmlaufsatz := by
  intro n _ v hsimple horient
  obtain ⟨a, hminIm, hminReOnTie⟩ := shift_zero_min_im_then_re v
  let w := shiftPolygon v a
  have hsimpleW : IsSimplePolygon w := by
    exact isSimplePolygon_shift hsimple a
  have horientW : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < crossR2 (w (i - 1)) (w i) (w (i + 1)) := by
    exact positiveOrientation_shift horient a
  have hsumW :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, cyclicEdgeTurn w i) = 2 * Real.pi :=
    sum_cyclicEdgeTurn_eq_two_pi_of_lex_min hsimpleW horientW
      hminIm hminReOnTie
  have hsumV :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, cyclicEdgeTurn v i) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    rw [← sum_cyclicEdgeTurn_shift v a]
    exact hsumW
  exact (hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_iff_sum v).2 hsumV

blocks.tex:
Choose as index zero a vertex with minimum imaginary coordinate and then
minimum real coordinate among ties. Simplicity makes separated edge segments
disjoint, so \cref{detail:discrete-secant-square} applies to each cell of the
finite secant grid. Sum the identities over the grid: interior terms cancel,
leaving the secants from the lowest vertex, the reverse boundary secants, and
twice the turn joining the last edge to the first. The lowest-vertex condition
places the boundary secants in a common upper half-plane, fixing the argument
branch; their two boundary sums and the joining turns total $2\pi$.
Positive consecutive orientation supplies the strict principal-angle bounds
and handles the boundary triangular cells. Cyclic shifting preserves the
sum, giving the result for the original indexing.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-edge-support
blocks.title: Positive one-turn polygons have strict edge support
blocks.body:
For such a polygon, every vertex other than an edge's endpoints lies strictly
in the left half-plane of that oriented edge. The same conclusion holds for
a closed positive moderate-arc development with total turn $2\pi$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne
lean.code:
theorem strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)))
    (hone : HasPositiveTurningNumberOne v) :
    StrictConvexEdgeSupport v := by
  intro a c hca hca1
  set t := (c - a).val
  have hb : ((t : ℕ) : ZMod n) = c - a :=
    ZMod.natCast_rightInverse (c - a)
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Nat.cast_zero] at hb
    exact hca (sub_eq_zero.1 hb.symm)
  have ht1 : t ≠ 1 := by
    intro h1
    rw [h1, Nat.cast_one] at hb
    exact hca1 (by linear_combination hb.symm)
  have htn : t < n := ZMod.val_lt (c - a)
  have hc : cyclicVertex v (a.val + t) = v c :=
    cyclicVertex_sub_val v a c
  have hleft :
      0 < (Complex.exp (((-cyclicEdgeHeading v a.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (v c - v a)).im := by
    rw [← hc, show v a = cyclicVertex v a.val by simp [cyclicVertex]]
    exact support_left_pos_of_turningNumberOne hsimple horient hone a.val
      (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [cyclicEdgeVector_at_val hsimple, crossR2_cyclicEdgeVector]
  exact mul_pos (cyclicEdgeLength_pos hsimple a.val) hleft

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation
lean.code:
theorem strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))) :
    StrictConvexEdgeSupport v :=
  strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne hsimple horient
    (hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation
      hsimple horient)

/-! ## The integral period defect -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.convexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne
lean.code:
theorem convexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)))
    (hone : HasPositiveTurningNumberOne v) :
    ConvexEdgeSupport v := by
  intro a c
  set t := (c - a).val
  have htlt : t < n := ZMod.val_lt (c - a)
  have hc : cyclicVertex v (a.val + t) = v c :=
    cyclicVertex_sub_val v a c
  have hleft :
      0 ≤ (Complex.exp (((-cyclicEdgeHeading v a.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (v c - v a)).im := by
    rw [← hc, show v a = cyclicVertex v a.val by simp [cyclicVertex]]
    exact support_left_nonneg_of_turningNumberOne hsimple horient hone a.val
      (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [cyclicEdgeVector_at_val hsimple, crossR2_cyclicEdgeVector]
  exact mul_nonneg (cyclicEdgeLength_pos hsimple a.val).le hleft

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi)
    (a c : ZMod n) (hca : c ≠ a) (hca1 : c ≠ a + 1) :
    0 < crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ a) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (a + 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ c) := by
  have hleft := support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT a c hca hca1
  rw [polygonR2_edgeVector hE hT, crossR2_edgeVector]
  exact mul_pos (h.length_pos a) hleft

blocks.tex:
Reconstruct each edge as its positive length times the exponential of its
lifted heading. Relative to a fixed edge, the left-distance of a later vertex
is a partial sum of these lengths times the sines of the heading differences.
The headings increase through exactly one period. Before the half-turn,
the partial sum is positive once past the incident vertex; after the
half-turn, use closure to write it as minus the remaining sum, whose sines
are negative. This gives positivity throughout the nonincident range.
Multiplication by the fixed positive edge length converts the left-distance
into the signed area. For the moderate-arc development, the given total-turn
equation supplies the same one-turn heading sequence directly.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-coherence
blocks.title: Moderate arcs give coherence and exact Menger curvature
blocks.body:
A positive moderate-arc development whose closure gap is zero and total turn
is $2\pi$ has signed Menger curvature $\kappa_i$ at each vertex, and the
circumcenter of its consecutive triple lies in the open vertex cone.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.coherent_development_moderate
lean.code:
theorem coherent_development_moderate [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    CoherentR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ) := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨ψ, ψ', hd, hem, hep⟩ := polygon_edges hE hT i
  have hl1 := h.length_pos (i - 1)
  have hl2 := h.length_pos i
  have hκi := hκ i
  have hθpos : 0 < turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i := turningAngle_pos h hκi
  have hθlt : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i < Real.pi := by
    have := abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h i
    rw [abs_lt] at this
    exact this.2
  have hsinθ : 0 < Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθpos hθlt
  have hprod := conj_edge_mul_edge hE hT i
  have hre_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).re
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.cos (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]
  have him_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.im_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
  have hcross : crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [crossR2_eq_im_conj_mul, him_eq]
    have : -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) < 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hl1 hl2) hsinθ]
    exact ne_of_lt this
  refine ⟨hcross, ?_⟩
  set A := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) with hA
  set B := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ i / 2)) with hB
  have hθAB : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i = A + B := by
    rw [turningAngle, hA, hB, tK_zero, tK_zero]
  have hargl : κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_left i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargr : κ i * (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_right i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargl0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl1)
  have hargr0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl2)
  have hsinA : Real.sin A = κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := by
    rw [hA]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargl.le
  have hsinB : Real.sin B = κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := by
    rw [hB]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargr.le
  have hcosA : 0 < Real.cos A := by
    rw [hA, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have hcosB : 0 < Real.cos B := by
    rw [hB, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have htrig := neg_sin_mul_cos_add_lt (hsinA ▸ hargl0) (hsinB ▸ hargr0)
    hcosA hcosB (by rw [← hθAB]; exact hsinθ)
  rw [hsinA, hsinB, lt_min_iff] at htrig
  have hnu : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ (i - 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hem, Complex.normSq_neg, normSq_scaled_exp]
  have hnw : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ 2 := by
  -- … (truncated)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_polygonR2
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerR2_polygonR2 [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hMA : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (i : ZMod n) :
    signedMengerR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1)) (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) =
      κ i := by
  have hpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  set k : ℕ := i.val + (n - 1) with hk
  have hn1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos, ZMod.natCast_self, Nat.cast_one, zero_sub]
  have hiv : ((i.val : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse i
  have hc0 : ((k : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i - 1 := by
    rw [hk, Nat.cast_add, hiv, hn1]; ring
  have hc1 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i := by
    rw [hk, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hiv, hn1]; ring
  have hc2 : ((k + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + 1 := by
    rw [hk, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hiv, hn1]; ring
  have e0 : vertexR2 κ ℓ k = polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) := by
    rw [vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT k, hc0]
  have e1 : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) = polygonR2 κ ℓ i := by
    rw [vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT (k + 1), hc1]
  have e2 : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1) = polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) := by
    rw [vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT (k + 1 + 1), hc2]
  rw [← e0, ← e1, ← e2, signedMengerR2_development hMA k, hc1]

/-! ## The collated statement -/

blocks.tex:
The tangent--chord calculation identifies the two incident half-angles with
the two arcsines defining the turning angle, so the three-point curvature is
exactly $\kappa_i$. Their strict bounds keep both half-angles acute and their
sum below $\pi$. The explicit circumcenter formula consequently has strictly
positive coordinates in the two inward cone directions. Closure and total
turn identify the natural-number development at indices differing by a period,
so the same computation applies across the cyclic seam.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-circumradius
blocks.title: Circumradius is reciprocal absolute Menger curvature
blocks.body:
For three noncollinear points, put $\Delta=(q-p)\times(r-p)$ and let $R$ be
their circumradius. Then
\[
 2|\Delta|R=|p-q|\,|q-r|\,|r-p|,\qquad
 R=\frac1{|\kappa_{\rm Menger}|}.
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexCircumradius
lean.code:
noncomputable def vertexCircumradius (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  dist (circumcenterR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1))) (v i)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.dist_circumcenterR2_mul
lean.code:
theorem dist_circumcenterR2_mul {p q r : ℂ} (h : crossR2 p q r ≠ 0) :
    dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p * (2 * |crossR2 p q r|) =
      dist p q * dist q r * dist r p := by
  set δ := crossR2 p q r with hδ
  set u := q - p with hu
  set w := r - p with hw
  set num : ℂ := (normSq w : ℂ) * u - (normSq u : ℂ) * w with hnum
  have hζ : (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) * (2 * (δ : ℂ)) = Complex.I * num := by
    have h2 : (2 * (δ : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.2 h)
    rw [circumcenterR2, add_sub_cancel_left, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2]
  have hsq : normSq (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) * (4 * δ ^ 2) =
      normSq u * normSq w * normSq (w - u) := by
    have := congrArg normSq hζ
    simp only [map_mul, Complex.normSq_I, Complex.normSq_ofReal, one_mul] at this
    have h2 : normSq (2 : ℂ) = 4 := by norm_num [Complex.normSq_apply]
    rw [h2] at this
    have hn : normSq num = normSq u * normSq w * normSq (w - u) := by
      simp only [hnum, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
      ring
    rw [← hn, ← this]
    ring
  have hL : 0 ≤ dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p * (2 * |δ|) := by positivity
  have hR : 0 ≤ dist p q * dist q r * dist r p := by positivity
  refine (pow_left_inj₀ hL hR two_ne_zero).1 ?_
  have e1 : dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p ^ 2 = normSq (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have e2 : dist p q ^ 2 = normSq u := by
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have e3 : dist q r ^ 2 = normSq (w - u) := by
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hw, hu, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
  have e4 : dist r p ^ 2 = normSq w := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  calc (dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p * (2 * |δ|)) ^ 2
      = dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p ^ 2 * (4 * δ ^ 2) := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]; ring
    _ = (dist p q * dist q r * dist r p) ^ 2 := by
        rw [e1, hsq, mul_pow, mul_pow, e2, e3, e4]; ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.dist_circumcenterR2_eq_inv_abs_signedMenger
lean.code:
theorem dist_circumcenterR2_eq_inv_abs_signedMenger {A B C : ℂ}
    (h : crossR2 B A C ≠ 0) :
    dist (circumcenterR2 B A C) B = 1 / |signedMengerR2 A B C| := by
  have hABC : crossR2 A B C = -crossR2 B A C := by
    rw [← crossR2_cycle A B C]; exact crossR2_swap B A C
  obtain ⟨hBA, hAC, hCB⟩ := pairwise_ne_of_crossR2_ne_zero h
  have hd1 : 0 < dist A B := dist_pos.2 (Ne.symm hBA)
  have hd2 : 0 < dist B C := dist_pos.2 (Ne.symm hCB)
  have hd3 : 0 < dist C A := dist_pos.2 (Ne.symm hAC)
  have hδ : 0 < |crossR2 B A C| := abs_pos.2 h
  have key := dist_circumcenterR2_mul h
  rw [signedMengerR2, hABC, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two,
    abs_of_pos hd1, abs_of_pos hd2, abs_of_pos hd3, one_div_div]
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
  rw [dist_comm B A, dist_comm C B, dist_comm A C] at key
  linarith [key]

/-! ## Menger curvature and circumradius of the realized polygon -/

blocks.tex:
Let $u=q-p$, $w=r-p$. The circumcenter displacement is
$i(|w|^2u-|u|^2w)/(2\Delta)$. Taking its squared norm and expanding gives
$|\,|w|^2u-|u|^2w\,|^2=|u|^2|w|^2|w-u|^2$.
All distances are nonnegative and $\Delta\ne0$, so taking square roots gives
the first identity. Divide by the nonzero product of side lengths and use
the definition of signed Menger curvature to obtain the second.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-radius-extrema
blocks.title: Reciprocation exchanges extrema and preserves the hypothesis
blocks.body:
For a positive cyclic radius word, taking reciprocals preserves every maximal
constant run and exchanges its strict maximum and minimum comparisons.
Consequently two distinct plateau maxima and two distinct plateau minima of
$r$ give the discrete four-vertex hypothesis for $\kappa_i=1/r_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.discreteFourVertexExtrema_inv
lean.code:
lemma discreteFourVertexExtrema_inv {r : ZMod n → ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (h : IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r) : DiscreteFourVertexExtrema (fun i => 1 / r i) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨a₁, k₁, a₂, k₂, hk₁, hk₂, hM₁, hM₂, hd⟩, ⟨b₁, j₁, b₂, j₂, hj₁, hj₂, hm₁, hm₂, he⟩⟩ := h
  exact ⟨fun i => one_div_pos.2 (hr i), Or.inr
    ⟨⟨b₁, j₁, b₂, j₂, hj₁, hj₂, plateauMinRun_inv hr hm₁, plateauMinRun_inv hr hm₂, he⟩,
     ⟨a₁, k₁, a₂, k₂, hk₁, hk₂, plateauMaxRun_inv hr hM₁, plateauMaxRun_inv hr hM₂, hd⟩⟩⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin
lean.code:
def IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin (r : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  HasTwoPlateauMaxRuns r ∧ HasTwoPlateauMinRuns r

blocks.tex:
The map $x\mapsto1/x$ is strictly decreasing on positive reals. Apply it to
the two outside-neighbour inequalities of each constant run. Equality inside
a run, its maximality, and disjointness of distinct runs are unchanged.

blocks.label: detail:discrete-radius-converse
blocks.title: Tabachnikov's radius formulation
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge4$. Every positive cyclic radius word with two plateau maxima and two
plateau minima is the consecutive circumradius word of a simple strictly
convex coherent polygon. Its signed Menger curvatures are $1/r_i$.
If all adjacent radii differ, no four consecutive vertices are concyclic.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikov_converse
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikov_converse [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {r : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hext : IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r) :
    ∃ v : ZMod n → ℂ, IsCoherentConvexPolygon v ∧
      (∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i) ∧
      (∀ i, signedMengerR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)) = 1 / r i) ∧
      ((∀ i, r i ≠ r (i + 1)) →
        ∀ i, ¬ Concyclic4 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 2))) := by
  set κ : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i => 1 / r i with hκdef
  have hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i := fun i => one_div_pos.2 (hr i)
  have hreal : RealizesR2 κ :=
    tabachnikovProblem2_iff_extrema_form.mp (tabachnikovProblem2_all hn) κ
      (discreteFourVertexExtrema_inv hr hext)
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hMA, hE, hT, hsimple⟩ := hreal
  have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by omega
  have hcoh := coherent_development_moderate hMA hκ hE hT
  have hmenger := signedMengerR2_polygonR2 hMA hE hT
  have hrad : ∀ i, vertexCircumradius (polygonR2 κ ℓ) i = r i := by
    intro i
    rw [vertexCircumradius, dist_circumcenterR2_eq_inv_abs_signedMenger (hcoh i).1,
      hmenger i, abs_of_pos (hκ i), hκdef, one_div_one_div]
  refine ⟨polygonR2 κ ℓ,
    ⟨hsimple, fun a c hca hca1 => crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos hMA hκ hE hT a c hca hca1,
      hcoh⟩, hrad, hmenger, ?_⟩
  intro hne i hcon
  apply hne i
  rw [← hrad i, ← hrad (i + 1)]
  exact vertexCircumradius_eq_of_concyclic i (hcoh i).1 (hcoh (i + 1)).1 hcon

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsCoherentConvexPolygon
lean.code:
def IsCoherentConvexPolygon (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsSimplePolygon v ∧
    (∀ a c : ZMod n, c ≠ a → c ≠ a + 1 → 0 < crossR2 (v a) (v (a + 1)) (v c)) ∧
    CoherentR2 v

blocks.tex:
Apply the four-active-edge converse to the reciprocal curvature word.
The preceding geometric lemmas give strict convexity, coherence, and the
prescribed radii. For the final assertion, four concyclic vertices would give
the two overlapping noncollinear triples the same circumcenter and radius.
Uniqueness follows by subtracting the three squared-distance equations,
which is a nonsingular two-by-two linear system. Thus their adjacent prescribed
radii would be equal, contradicting the hypothesis.
